subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493 DR.
source_quote: 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: stone giant presence
fact: A very large and very venerable stone giant sits on a rock near Laduguer’s Furrow.
source_quote: sitting on a rock is a very large and very venerable stone giant

subject: Deep King’s domain
fact: The Deep King rules from a city where order escapes as control increases, and evil permeates below.
source_quote: The Deep King has tried to keep order and control, and the more he trie,s the more the order escapes and tries to take the city from him.

subject: stonespeaker crystal
fact: A 19 inch shard of quartz crystal enables Speak with Animals, Speak with the Dead, Speak with Plants, and aids divination.
source_quote: a 19 inch shard of quartz crystal... Speak with Animals, Speak with the Dead, and Speak with Plants... aids divinations

subject: Derro slums
fact: The Derro slums are a chaotic, unplanned district of burrows and piled structures, reeking of squalor and madness.
source_quote: homes... mostly burrows carved into the walls and simple structures piled atop one another... dirty and cluttered streets... formed as dwellings spread and came together

subject: Whorlstone Caverns access
fact: A secret fissure behind moldy boxes and canvas in West Cleft leads to the Whorlstone Caverns, marked by eerie fog.
source_quote: lifts the scrap of cloth, pushes the gray sheets of canvas to the side, revealing a narrow fissure... a wisp of eerie fog floats out

subject: Buppido’s shrine
fact: A macabre altar of bones and skeletons arranged in a spiral pattern, tended by a deranged cultist named Buppido.
source_quote: cluster of skeletons around Buppido... arranged in a spiral pattern around the cave’s center

subject: Droki’s passage
fact: Droki moves with unnatural speed through Derro slums, delivering messages while appearing oblivious to surveillance.
source_quote: Droki also doesn’t seem to care if anyone is following him... walking too quickly for a Derro, as if there was something magical about his pace

subject: Faerzress Cavern
fact: A long cavern lined with stalactites and stalagmites, where water drips silently and faerzress casts eerie spiral light.
source_quote: long cavern lined with stalactites and stalagmites... glow of faerzress casts an eerie soft light... swirling into spiral patterns... the dripping of water makes no echo

subject: Shal the advisor
fact: Shal is a mysterious new advisor to the Deep King, whose influence has caused the king to reject sage counsel.
source_quote: Shal, an advisor of his. Ever since they became friends, The Deep King has been unwilling to listen to any sage advice.

subject: Great Sundering
fact: The end of the Great Sundering ended the era that allowed the gods to walk freely in Faerûn, enabling modern demonic incursions.
source_quote: The end of the great sundering ended the era that allowed the gods to walk in Faerûn freely.

subject: demonic manifestations
fact: Demons at Valkenvylve, the Beholder in Spidersilk Caves, demonic manta rays, and Demogorgon are not localized but part of a coordinated resurgence.
source_quote: The demons at Valkenvylve, the Beholder in the Spidersilk caves, the demonic manta rays, and Demogorgon, all of this is no coincidence.

subject: Cult of Tiamat ritual
fact: The Cult of Tiamat resorted to an extraordinary ritual to bring her into the prime material plane due to the loss of divine freedom.
source_quote: It’s why the Cult of Tiamat had to resort to such an extraordinary ritual to bring her into the prime material plane.

subject: Laduguer’s Furrow
fact: Laduguer’s Furrow is a clean, orderly corridor with entrances on either side, contrasting sharply with the Derro slums to the west.
source_quote: at either edge of this Furrow is an entrance... spotlessly clean in its style

subject: Buppido’s betrayal
fact: Buppido, once a captive, has become a cultist building a shrine to himself, claiming divine mandate.
source_quote: I didn’t expect you to find me here, with my shrine nearly finished! And power! My faithful are finally honoring me!

subject: West Cleft District
fact: West Cleft is a former slave district, now abandoned guardhouses serve as vantage points overlooking Derro territory.
source_quote: The duergar built a series of guardhouses to keep an eye on their derro slaves living in the West Cleft. These were abandoned when Deepking Tarngardt... liberated the derro

subject: East Cleft District
fact: East Cleft is the expanded territory of the liberated Derro, now densely populated and chaotic.
source_quote: allowing them to spread from the West Cleft District into the East Cleft District

subject: Council of Savants
fact: The Council of Savants promised freedom to the Derro but failed to deliver, inciting rage and religious fervor.
source_quote: The Council of Savants who promised freedom and failed to deliver freedom... The Council of Savants will fail my people.

subject: Daz’s spellcasting
fact: Daz casts Fairie Fire to mark three skeletons, granting advantage to allies attacking them.
source_quote: Daz casts Fairie Fire. Suddenly, three skeletons are marked, and an ethereal glow surrounds them.

subject: Zalthir’s darkness
fact: Zalthir plunges the cavern into darkness to disorient undead and disrupt Buppido’s control.
source_quote: Zalthir, never one to shy away from unusual tactics, plunges the area into darkness.

subject: Grygum’s turning undead
fact: Grygum turns undead after Zalthir’s darkness lifts, slaughtering Buppido’s skeletal minions.
source_quote: The cleric’s words of power overwhelm the skeletal minions of Buppido. The battle was evenly matched, but now it will become a slaughter.

subject: Ghohlbrorn’s Lair
fact: Ghohlbrorn’s Lair is where Jimjar plays games of chance and Buppido is held captive before his escape.
source_quote: head back to Ghohlbrorn’s Lair, where they find Jimjar playing a game of chance

subject: Cairngorm Cavern
fact: Cairngorm Cavern is the starting point for journeys to Laduguer’s Furrow and the Derro slums.
source_quote: From the Cairngorm Cavern, Laduguer’s Furrow is just a short distance

subject: Themberchaud’s cave
fact: Themberchaud’s cave is the origin point of Thorin’s journey toward the Cairngorm Cavern.
source_quote: From Themberchaud’s cave to the Cairngorm Cavern

subject: Hgraam’s cave
fact: Hgraam’s cave is the dwelling of the ancient stone giant who speaks in riddles and bestows the stonespeaker crystal.
source_quote: he heads back into his cave

subject: Duergar city
fact: Duergar city is a place of rigid order where only Duergar are permitted, contrasting with the chaos of Derro districts.
source_quote: where no one but the Duergar is allowed

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is a vast, evil-infested realm where madness creeps from the blackest depths and the rock itself cries in pain.
source_quote: Something evil stirs in the Underdark. The rock itself cries in pain and horror, and a madness creeps from the blackest depths.

subject: Daz’s question about Grey Ghosts
fact: Daz asks about Grey Ghosts, prompting Hgraam to lament the Deep King’s descent into paranoia.
source_quote: Grey Ghosts? The Deep King creates so many enemies. He used to be so calm. He and I would watch the stones grow.

subject: Spidersilk Caves
fact: The Spidersilk Caves are a site of demonic presence, noted as one of many non-localized demonic manifestations.
source_quote: the Beholder in the Spidersilk caves

subject: Valkenvylve
fact: Valkenvylve is a location where demons have appeared, part of a pattern of widespread demonic incursions.
source_quote: The demons at Valkenvylve

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan is referenced as a Drow city that enslaves similarly to the Duergar, prompting moral reflection.
source_quote: how the Drow of Menzoberranzan do it

subject: Thorin’s realization about Deep King’s police
fact: Thorin deduces that the Deep King uses secret invisible police to control the city, causing opposition to flee underground.
source_quote: The Deep King has relied on his secret invisible police to control the city, and so opposition has gone underneath it.

subject: Derro’s tunnels
fact: The Derro tunnels are accessed only by bypassing Duergar-controlled routes, as direct passage triggers bloodshed.
source_quote: To get to the tunnels, the Duergar would have to go through the Derro, and that would trigger a bloodbath.

subject: Laduguer’s Furrow
fact: Laduguer’s Furrow is a clean, narrow corridor separating Duergar territory from Derro slums, with abandoned guardhouses.
source_quote: Laduguer’s Furrow is just a short distance... abandoned guardhouses now stand empty

subject: Grygum’s pursuit of Droki
fact: Grygum follows Droki into Derro city and witnesses his passage through a hidden fissure into the Whorlstone Caverns.
source_quote: Grygum gets up and follows Droki into Derro city... jumps into the crack

subject: West Cleft
fact: West Cleft is a Derro district where Droki’s hidden entrance lies, and where Buppido’s shrine is later found.
source_quote: stops between a cluster of hovels in West Cleft

subject: Cavern of Bones
fact: A cavern carpeted with humanoid remains arranged in a spiral, where Buppido has built his shrine.
source_quote: floor is carpeted with humanoid remains in varying stages of decomposition, arranged in a spiral pattern around the cave’s center

subject: Ghohlbrorn’s Lair
fact: Ghohlbrorn’s Lair is where Buppido was held captive and where Jimjar plays games of chance.
source_quote: head back to Ghohlbrorn’s Lair, where they find Jimjar playing a game of chance

subject: Cairngorm Cavern
fact: Cairngorm Cavern is the origin point of Zalthir’s journey to Laduguer’s Furrow.
source_quote: From the Cairngorm Cavern, Laduguer’s Furrow is just a short distance

subject: Zalthir’s observation of Derro slums
fact: Zalthir observes the Derro slums and concludes why non-Duergar are needed to navigate them safely.
source_quote: And now, why Errde Blackstaff and the Keeper of the Flames were so anxious to find a non-Duergar to come here is clear.

subject: Thorin’s threat to Buppido
fact: Thorin whispers a threat to Buppido if he betrays them after freeing him.
source_quote: If you betray us, I will gut you.

subject: Buppido’s divine claim
fact: Buppido claims his actions are guided by a divine plan, justifying his betrayal and cultism.
source_quote: The divine plan tells me I must help you!

subject: Whorlstone Caverns
fact: Whorlstone Caverns are a secret network accessible only through hidden fissures in West Cleft, used by Droki.
source_quote: Droki is someone all of the factions trust and can get to the Whorlstone Caverns safely

subject: Daz’s discovery of Buppido’s shrine
fact: Daz discovers Buppido has become a cult leader, building a shrine to himself amid bones and skeletons.
source_quote: I didn’t expect you to find me here, with my shrine nearly finished! And power! My faithful are finally honoring me!

subject: Cavern of Whispering Echoes
fact: A cavern where the sound of dripping water makes no echo, suggesting magical dampening or distortion.
source_quote: the dripping of water makes no echo, as if Daz stood in open air

subject: Faerzress-affected Zone
fact: A region where the Faerzress distorts perception and sanity, casting spiral patterns and muting sound.
source_quote: The glow of faerzress casts an eerie soft light... swirling into spiral patterns... the sound around you is strangely muted

subject: Zalthir’s reflection on Stone Giants
fact: Zalthir reflects that the Stone Giants’ patience and subtlety may offer lessons to his monastic order.
source_quote: Perhaps there is something that even his monastic order could learn from their subtlety and patience.

subject: Droki’s Path
fact: Droki’s path is a well-worn trail marked by dropped junk, making him predictable and reliable for faction couriers.
source_quote: Droki's path is very well worn and marked with junk that the Derro drops.

subject: Deep King’s Citadel
fact: The Deep King’s citadel is the seat of power where paranoia has taken root since Shal’s arrival.
source_quote: The Deep King has been unwilling to listen to any sage advice.

subject: Cairngorm Cavern
fact: Cairngorm Cavern is the origin point of Zalthir’s journey to Laduguer’s Furrow.
source_quote: From the Cairngorm Cavern, Laduguer’s Furrow is just a short distance
